title: Central Authority's Opportunity to Express Views

content.scenario: The Central Government is considering issuing a direction to the Central Authority regarding a new consumer protection policy. Before doing so, the Government must decide whether to consult the Central Authority.
content.outcome: The Central Authority shall be given an opportunity to express its views before the Central Government gives any direction, as far as practicable.

user_queries: Does the Central Authority have a say in government directions?
How does the Central Government direct the Central Authority?
What is the process for Central Authority feedback?
